2608.05148.title: Reasoning Core: Designing Broad Procedural Data for Completion-Supervised Reasoning Training
2608.05148.paper_summary: Procedural generators produce useful verifiable reasoning problems at scale, but have received less attention as data for completion-supervised fine-tuning. We introduce Reasoning Core, a collection of 50 generators spanning mathematics, logic, planning, state tracking, formal languages, structured data, games, causality, and code, with semantic scorers, difficulty controls, and task evaluators. Under a matched completion-supervised protocol, we compare Reasoning Core with Procedural Warmup, Reasoning Gym, and SynLogic across four base-model settings and multiple training durations. In the primary 3B comparison, Reasoning Core achieves the highest mean scores on DROP, LogiQA, and ARC-Challenge, exceeding both the baseline without procedural data and all three alternative procedural collections. Task-level analyses show that semantic validity alone does not ensure training utility, highlighting compact targets and calibrated difficulty as important design factors. We ran audits combining model-assisted review, human adjudication, and regression testing. Applied throughout Reasoning Core development and to the other collections, they reveal subtle mismatches among generation, rendering, targets, and scoring, a reminder that procedural generation alone does not guarantee correctness. The library, generated datasets, and audit material are publicly available.
2608.05148.paper_summary_zh: 程序生成器能夠大規模產生有用的可驗證推理問題，但在完成監督微調的數據上受到的關注較少。我們介紹了推理核心（Reasoning Core），這是一個包含50個生成器的集合，涵蓋數學、邏輯、規劃、狀態追蹤、形式語言、結構化數據、遊戲、因果關係和代碼，並具備語義評分器、難度控制和任務評估器。在匹配的完成監督協議下，我們將推理核心與程序熱身（Procedural Warmup）、推理健身房（Reasoning Gym）和SynLogic在四個基礎模型設置和多個訓練時長下進行比較。在主要的3B比較中，推理核心在DROP、LogiQA和ARC-Challenge上達到了最高的平均分數，超過了沒有程序數據的基準以及所有三個替代的程序集合。任務級別的分析顯示，僅僅具備語義有效性並不能確保訓練的實用性，突顯出緊湊的目標和校準的難度是重要的設計因素。我們進行了結合模型輔助審查、人類裁定和回歸測試的審計。這些審計在推理核心的開發過程中以及對其他集合的應用中，揭示了生成、渲染、目標和評分之間的微妙不匹配，提醒我們僅靠程序生成並不能保證正確性。該庫、生成的數據集和審計材料均可公開獲得。
